quranTranslation.text: And when he came unto the water of Midian he found there a whole tribe of men, watering. And he found apart from them two women keeping back (their flocks). He said: What aileth you? The two said: We cannot give (our flocks) to drink till the shepherds return from the water; and our father is a very old man.

explanation.bs: „A naš otac je starac u poodmaklim godinama“ – كَبِير za starost.
explanation.en: “Our father is a very old man” — كَبِير for age.

quranTranslation.text: He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak.

explanation.bs: „Nego, ovaj najveći među njima je to uradio“ – Ibrahim o najvećem idolu.
explanation.en: “But this, their chief hath done it” — Abraham on the largest idol, their chief.

quranTranslation.text: They question thee about strong drink and games of chance. Say: In both is great sin, and (some) utility for men; but the sin of them is greater than their usefulness. And they ask thee what they ought to spend. Say: that which is superfluous. Thus Allah maketh plain to you (His) revelations, that haply ye may reflect.

explanation.bs: „U oba je velik grijeh“ – veličina mjerena prema koristi.
explanation.en: “In both is great sin” — greatness weighed against the benefit.

quranTranslation.text: And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature.

explanation.bs: „I ti si, zaista, velike naravi“ – veličina karaktera, koja se ne vidi okom.
explanation.en: “And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature” — greatness of character, not seen with the eye.

quranTranslation.text: Allah! There is no deity save Him, the Alive, the Eternal. Neither slumber nor sleep overtaketh Him. Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Who is he that intercedeth with Him save by His leave? He knoweth that which is in front of them and that which is behind them, while they encompass nothing of His knowledge save what He will. His throne includeth the heavens and the earth, and He is never weary of preserving them. He is the Sublime, the Tremendous.

explanation.bs: On je Uzvišeni, Veličanstveni – Allahovo ime.
explanation.en: He is the Most High, the Most Great — a name of Allah.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! I found a woman ruling over them, and she hath been given (abundance) of all things, and hers is a mighty throne.

explanation.bs: Ona ima veličanstven prijesto – kraljica Sabe: عَظِيم i za ljudske stvari.
explanation.en: She has a great throne — the queen of Sabaʾ: عَظِيم also of human things.

quranTranslation.text: The month of Ramadan in which was revealed the Qur'an, a guidance for mankind, and clear proofs of the guidance, and the Criterion (of right and wrong). And whosoever of you is present, let him fast the month, and whosoever of you is sick or on a journey, (let him fast the same) number of other days. Allah desireth for you ease; He desireth not hardship for you; and (He desireth) that ye should complete the period, and that ye should magnify Allah for having guided you, and that peradventure ye may be thankful.

explanation.bs: „Allah vam želi olakšanje, a ne želi vam poteškoću“ – ar-Rāġib: ovdje htijenje u značenju onoga što Allah naređuje i želi za vas.
explanation.en: “Allah desireth for you ease; He desireth not hardship for you” — ar-Rāġib: here wanting in the sense of what Allah commands and wants for you.

quranTranslation.text: As for that Abode of the Hereafter We assign it unto those who seek not oppression in the earth, nor yet corruption. The sequel is for those who ward off (evil).

explanation.bs: Onaj svijet je za one „koji ne žele oholo uzdizanje na Zemlji“ – htijenje kao namjera i cilj.
explanation.en: “As for that Abode of the Hereafter We assign it unto those who seek not oppression [ʿuluww: self-exaltation] in the earth” — ‘seek’ is yurīdūna: wanting as intent and aim.

quranTranslation.text: So they twain journeyed on till, when they came unto the folk of a certain township, they asked its folk for food, but they refused to make them guests. And they found therein a wall upon the point of falling into ruin, and he repaired it. (Moses) said: If thou hadst wished, thou couldst have taken payment for it.

explanation.bs: „Zid koji se samo što nije srušio“ (doslovno: koji ‚hoće‘ da se sruši) – ar-Rāġib: htijenje može proisticati i iz prirodne sile, pa se riječ kaže i za ono što nema izbora.
explanation.en: “A wall upon the point of falling into ruin” (literally: that ‘wants’ to collapse) — ar-Rāġib: will can also follow a compelled force, so the word is said even of what has no choice.

quranTranslation.text: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.

explanation.bs: „A vi ne htijete, osim ako to Allah htjedne“ – čovjekova volja je pod Allahovom.
explanation.en: “Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth” — man's will stands under Allah's.

quranTranslation.text: Except if Allah will. And remember thy Lord when thou forgettest, and say: It may be that my Lord guideth me unto a nearer way of truth than this.

explanation.bs: „…osim ako Allah htjedne“ – izraz kojim se svaka buduća namjera veže za Allahovu volju.
explanation.en: “Except if Allah will” — the phrase that ties every future intent to Allah's will.

quranTranslation.text: Say: (It is) the truth from the Lord of you (all). Then whosoever will, let him believe, and whosoever will, let him disbelieve. Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers Fire. Its tent encloseth them. If they ask for showers, they will be showered with water like to molten lead which burneth the faces. Calamitous the drink and ill the resting-place!

explanation.bs: „Pa onaj ko hoće neka povjeruje, a onaj ko hoće neka ne vjeruje“ – ista riječ i za čovjekov izbor.
explanation.en: “Then whosoever will, let him believe, and whosoever will, let him disbelieve” — the same word for man's choice.

quranTranslation.text: And have appointed your sleep for repose,

explanation.bs: „I san vaš smo učinili odmorom“ – san kao odmor.
explanation.en: “And have appointed your sleep for repose” — sleep as rest.

quranTranslation.text: And He it is Who maketh night a covering for you, and sleep repose, and maketh day a resurrection.

explanation.bs: „On je Onaj Koji vam je noć učinio odjećom, a san počinkom“ – san kao Allahov dar.
explanation.en: “And He it is Who maketh night a covering for you, and sleep repose” — sleep as Allah's gift.

quranTranslation.text: When He made the slumber fall upon you as a reassurance from him and sent down water from the sky upon you, that thereby He might purify you, and remove from you the fear of Satan, and make strong your hearts and firm (your) feet thereby.

explanation.bs: „Kad vas je obavio drijemežom, kao sigurnošću od Sebe“ – lagani san kao smirenje pred boj.
explanation.en: “When He made the slumber fall upon you as a reassurance from him” — light sleep as calm before battle.

quranTranslation.text: Then, after grief, He sent down security for you. As slumber did it overcome a party of you, while (the other) party, who were anxious on their own account, thought wrongly of Allah, the thought of ignorance. They said: Have we any part in the cause? Say (O Muhammad): The cause belongeth wholly to Allah. They hide within themselves (a thought) which they reveal not unto thee, saying: Had we had any part in the cause we should not have been slain here. Say: Even though ye had been in your houses, those appointed to be slain would have gone forth to the places where they were to lie. (All this hath been) in order that Allah might try what is in your breasts and prove what is in your hearts. Allah is Aware of what is hidden in the breasts (of men).

explanation.bs: „Zatim vam je, nakon tuge, spustio spokoj – drijemež koji je obuzeo jedan dio vas“ – nakon Uhuda.
explanation.en: “Then, after grief, He sent down security for you. As slumber did it overcome a party of you” — after Uhud.

quranTranslation.text: And thou wouldst have deemed them waking though they were asleep, and We caused them to turn over to the right and the left, and their dog stretching out his paws on the threshold. If thou hadst observed them closely thou hadst assuredly turned away from them in flight, and hadst been filled with awe of them.

explanation.bs: „I ti bi mislio da su budni, a oni spavaju (رُقُود)“ – san koji izgleda kao budnost.
explanation.en: “And thou wouldst have deemed them waking though they were asleep (رُقُود)” — a sleep that looks like waking.

quranTranslation.text: Such is Allah, your Lord. There is no Allah save Him, the Creator of all things, so worship Him. And He taketh care of all things.

explanation.bs: „Takav je Allah, vaš Gospodar: drugog boga osim Njega nema, On je Stvoritelj svake stvari – zato Njemu služite …“ – kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “Such is Allah, your Lord. There is no Allah save Him, the Creator of all things, so worship Him” — as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators!

explanation.bs: „… pa neizmjerno je blagoslovljen Allah, najbolji među stvarateljima“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet i objašnjava ga kao ‚najbolji od onih koji odmjeravaju‘, ili kao rečeno prema onome što su ljudi tvrdili.
explanation.en: “So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators!” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah and explains it as ‘the best of those who measure’, or as said on the terms of what people claimed.

quranTranslation.text: And when Moses said unto his people: O my people! Ye have wronged yourselves by your choosing of the calf (for worship) so turn in penitence to your Creator, and kill (the guilty) yourselves. That will be best for you with your Creator and He will relent toward you. Lo! He is the Relenting, the Merciful.

explanation.bs: „… pa se pokajte svome Davaocu postojanja …“ – Musa narodu nakon teleta; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… so turn in penitence to your Creator [bāriʾ]” — Moses to his people after the calf; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.
